desc: Implement reading input N, R, C, and string S.
Compute prefix sums of displacements for S, storing them in a list.
Use a set to keep track of all prefix sums seen so far.
For each t from 1 to N, check if P_t - (R,C) is in the set of prefix sums P_0 to P_t.
Build the result string and print it.
